root_audit: The affine mapping torus is identified with its linear model by the displayed path; its integral marked cohomology basis is retained.
The fixed exterior image is forced integrally by all n=1 reference spheres, without dependence on the variable cap gluing.
The exact transfer columns have index g|n| and first determinantal divisor g, yielding Smith factors g,|n|.
The Thom sequence, Poincare duality and universal coefficient sequence give all homology groups, including the n=0 free sector.
The free (9,3,1) example has the extra Z/3 summand and refutes the supplied general numerator row.
